enchant_guidance.label: Should Rogue Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 2?
enchant_guidance.text: Just like in Phase 1, choosing your Shattrath faction either  or  doesn't make that big of a difference in terms of raid performance. The main longstanding benefit will be the shoulder enchants from these factions.  from The Aldor is very slightly better than  from The Scryer's, but it is such a minuscule difference that you are unlikely to ever notice it. You will do just fine choosing whichever faction you prefer.
